title: A 2X2 Matrix Approach to Hopf Fibrations:: Quaternionic Reduction of Octonionic Bi-unitary Matrices and an RLLR/LRRL Bracketing Rule
summary: We develop a common two-by-two matrix framework for the four classical Hopf fibrations associated with the real, complex, quaternionic and octonionic numbers. In all four cases the Hopf map is the image of the north pole of a sphere of trace-free Hermitian matrices under conjugation by a bi-unitary matrix, and it depends only on the first column of that matrix, without any bracketing convention, even for the non-associative octonions.
